metadata.title: IASP91 crust over a constant mantle half-space
metadata.reference: Kennett and Engdahl (1991), Geophys. J. Int. 105, 429–465.
metadata.depth_reference: IASP91 surface mapped to zero flat depth.
metadata.notes: Flat approximation for crustal comparisons. Velocities just below the 35 km Moho are held constant in the half-space. Use the full spherical IASP91 model for teleseismic travel times.
